raw_snippet: Sacra estimates that Replit hit $525M in annualized revenue in April 2026, up from $300M at the end of 2025
dispute_text: An annualised month reported by the press or the company, not booked or audited revenue, and often sourced to the company itself.
note: Sacra estimate; Replit itself only says it is 'on track' for $1B run-rate by end-2026 (a forecast, not stored). published_date is the read date.
